fullSynopsis: Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are digging up a dinosaur bone on a cliff when it collapses, stranding them on a ledge. The pups rescue them and bring the bone down to complete a T-Rex skeleton in Adventure Bay.
aliases: the one with the dinosaur bone
the one with the t rex skeleton
paw patrol save a big bone

title: Pups Save a Floundering Francois
shortDescription: The Flounder hits a rock while whale watching, and Francois is later thrown overboard.
fullSynopsis: Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are whale watching when the Flounder hits a rock and starts to sink. The pups fix the boat, but a storm later throws Francois overboard and Ryder, Zuma and Skye rescue him.
aliases: the one where francois falls overboard
the one where the flounder hits a rock

shortDescription: Mayor Goodway's backpack, with Chickaletta inside, lands near an eagle's nest.
fullSynopsis: On a hike, Mayor Goodway's backpack slips down a cliff with Chickaletta in it and ends up on a limb near an eagle's nest. Skye goes down to rescue it, and the mother eagle is reunited with her eaglet.

fullSynopsis: Digging for fossils with Cap'n Turbot, the pups unearth three fossilized eggs that hatch into baby pterodactyls running around Adventure Bay. The PAW Patrol has to round up the dinosaurs.
